test_astype_with_dtype: test the Series.astype method to convert a Series to a specified numpy dtype
test_astype_with_dict_mapping: test the Series.astype method using a dict mapping column names to target dtypes
test_astype_datetime_to_str: test converting a datetime Series to string dtype with timezone-aware formatting
test_astype_categorical_roundtrip: test converting a categorical Series to other dtypes and back with preserved categories
test_astype_extension_dtype_errors: test the errors parameter in Series.astype for extension dtypes with raise and ignore modes
